rival_meanings.all_nonzero_body: Recolor every occupied body cell in nonzero-header rows.
rival_meanings.bbox_area: Rank post-recolor components by bounding-box area instead of occupied-cell count.
rival_meanings.column_header: Use the top cell of the current column as the key instead of the row header.
rival_meanings.crop_box: Crop the full recolored grid to the selected component's bbox, preserving unrelated clutter inside it.
rival_meanings.diagonal_components: Select largest same-color8-connected component after recoloring.
rival_meanings.erase_nonmarker_body: Erase body cells originally neither0 nor8 after recoloring.
rival_meanings.first_marker_only: Recolor only the first body8 in each row with a nonzero header.
rival_meanings.fixed_output2: Render the selected component in fixed color2.
rival_meanings.fixed_output8: Render the selected component in fixed color8.
rival_meanings.foreground_components: Select largest colorblind4-connected foreground component; retain its recolored cell values.
rival_meanings.global_color: Aggregate every cell of a color irrespective of connectivity, then select largest color total.
rival_meanings.global_first_header: Replace every body8 by the first nonzero row header, or0 if no header exists.
rival_meanings.ignore_eights: Exclude all color8 components from post-recolor selection.
rival_meanings.keep_canvas: Render the selected component at its original coordinates on the full input canvas.
rival_meanings.last_marker_only: Recolor only the last body8 in each row with a nonzero header.
rival_meanings.select_before_recolor: Select the largest input component, then render only its original cells with their recolored values.
rival_meanings.skip_recolor: Skip row recoloring; row mode is identity, largest mode selects from the input.
rival_meanings.solid_box: Fill the selected component's entire bounding box in its color.
rival_meanings.tie_high_color: Largest ties prefer the numerically highest color, then first occupied anchor.
rival_meanings.tie_last_anchor: Largest ties use the lexicographically last occupied anchor.
rival_meanings.tie_low_color: Largest ties prefer the numerically lowest color, then first occupied anchor.
rival_meanings.zero_header_recolors: Apply the header even when it is0, erasing those body8 cells.
